title: Short delta "15m" less than most recent delta of 5m
symptom: The short delta "15m" is less than the most recent delta of 5m even when blood glucose has risen every 5 minutes. Long delta is also wrong. For example, if BYODA readings are 132, 129, 128, 127, then delta reads +3, 15m reads +2, and 40m reads +1.
cause: Long deltas are calculated as an average value of deltas in the past, not as the total change over the time period.
fix: No fix needed; the behavior is by design. The deltas represent the average change over the period, not the total change.
evidence_quote: long deltas are calculates as an average value of deltas in the past
